Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.

WITH RECURSIVE customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, TRY_CAST(MIN(txn_date) AS DATE) as min_date, TRY_CAST(MAX(txn_date) AS DATE) as max_date 
    FROM customer_transactions 
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT customer_id, min_date as curr_date 
    FROM customer_date_ranges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ds.customer_id, ds.curr_date + INTERVAL '1 day' as curr_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN customer_date_ranges dr ON ds.customer_id = dr.customer_id
    WHERE ds.curr_date < dr.max_date
),
transactions_with_date AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        TRY_CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.customer_id,
        ds.curr_date as day_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount
                WHEN t.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -t.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) as balance_change
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN transactions_with_date t ON ds.customer_id = t.customer_id AND ds.curr_date = t.txn_date
    GROUP BY ds.customer_id, ds.curr_date
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        day_date,
        GREATEST(0, SUM(balance_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)) as daily_balance
    FROM daily_changes
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day_date) as month,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day_date)
)
SELECT 
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as num_customers,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) as total_max_balance
FROM monthly_max_balances
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
